== English Anthology family comparison ==
The original white-border face already gives +3, limited to a starship. The 1998 black-border face applies the bonus to anything he pilots, uses 'When piloting' for Rogue 3 and rephrases the One More Pass search. The cost, quantity, draw and maneuver clauses are retained. In March 2015 the Players Committee applied the already-published Special Edition wording to the white-border printing. The announcement's retrospective '+2' differs from the original white face. The later digital rendition is linked as the same gameplay state, with its own exact source and image.
